The instrument-calibration narrative and spectrograph-calibration position were expanded because they share a structural kinship with this document — both concern verification, documentation, and standardized procedures against baselines, which the Pallasine checklist also embodies. The Diagnostic First decision was expanded because it is a methodology-level position about structured engagement phases that could frame or be extended by an onboarding process. The Thematic door returned empty (no areas defined), so there are no additional thematic areas to explore. I did not expand further into the calibration expressions themselves since their spectrograph-specific content does not overlap with onboarding.
